We need to evaluate model using test set and cross-validation. There are functions evaluate_xgboost_model and perform_cross_validation. Use evaluate_xgboost_model with model_path and test_data_path from metadata. Also need cross-validation on training data. Use perform_cross_validation with train_data_path.

First, extract paths from metadata: train_path, test_path. Let's read metadata JSON to parse but we have it already. We'll call evaluate_xgboost_model.
